ns2:section.sectionText: Placement in this course requires a recent U of I Math Placement Exam score of at least 40%, with 50%-64% strongly recommended. Failure to achieve the minimum score will result in removal from the course after the fifth business day of spring term. Students with lower scores are encouraged to work through the Learning Module during fall and winter break until they have reached the level of mathematical knowledge expected for this course. For details see http://math.illinois.edu/ALEKS. This class has evening exams on Wednesdays: February 9, March 9, and April 20.
